verdict.rationale: Featurebase documents in-app feedback widgets and embeddable changelog widgets, and its featurebase-js SDK claims setup in four lines. However, the documented SDK path involves installing and importing a package (core or React helper), which implies a build step, and it targets the Messenger rather than the feedback widget specifically. missing for 10: evidence of a single <script> tag snippet, a confirmed no-build/CDN embed path for the feedback widget, independent hands-on corroboration.
